verdict.rationale: Sunbiz is a state government business-entity registry and filing portal, not an automation platform. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user automations is outside this kind of product's category. Nothing in the evidence shows it offers user-defined automations; amended annual reports and reinstatements are filing actions, not automation version control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
